name: Xi'an ChenXi Aviation Technology Corp., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an ChenXi Aviation Technology Corp., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of aviation electromechanical products in China. The company offers aviation inertial navigation products, including flexible strapdown inertial navigation systems, fiber optic strapdown inertial navigation systems, laser strapdown inertial navigation systems, piezoelectric strapdown inertial navigation systems, and navigation computer components; and aero-engine electronics products, such as aero-engine parameter acquisition units, flight control computers, and aero-engine electronic control systems.
